Method of Attack: Triangulate location of infected devices through WiFi scanning and Google's geolocation API
Abuse Windows WLAN API to collect WiFi access point data
Send HTTPS POST requests with WiFi data to Google's geolocation API
Send detailed geographic and network info to command and control (C2) server every 60 seconds
Attack Vector: WiFi scanning and HTTPS POST requests to C2 server
Indicators of Compromise: Version number '1' in initial POST request to C2
WiFi access point information in JSON format sent to Google's geolocation API and C2 server
